description_en: Queries the resource specifications that are supported by different types of scaling plans of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 查询集群的不同类型弹性计划支持的规格列表
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-elastic-plan-specifications --type EXECUTOR --db-cluster-id amv-wz9509beptiz0000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeElasticPlanSpecifications

parameters.help_en:
The type of the scaling plan. Valid values:

EXECUTOR: the interactive resource group type, which specifies the computing resource type.
WORKER: the elastic I/O unit (EIU) type
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划类型。 取值说明：

EXECUTOR：Interactive资源组，即计算资源类型。
WORKER：存储加速服务（EIU）
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource group.



This parameter must be specified only when you query the resource specifications that are supported by an interactive resource group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459446.html operation to query the name of a resource group within a cluster
parameters.help_zh:
资源组名称。

查询Interactive资源组的弹性计划（即计算资源类型的弹性计划）支持的规格时，必须指定资源组名称。查询存储加速服务（EIU）的弹性计划支持的规格时，无需指定资源组名称。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459446.html接口可以查看指定集群的资源组名称
parameters.name: resource_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口可以查看集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
